The '''CN-21''' was a type of camouflage paint produced by [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 40 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The paste looked [[Color/Legends|gray]] in the container, but had photoreactive pigments allowing it to match its environment once exposed to air.<ref name="DC" />
